args.title: Bellwether freight pricing — Q summary (main + companion)
args.body:
Combined summary of Bellwether blog "Freight pricing this quarter" and its subscriber companion piece:

- Spot rates fell 9% this quarter, while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece: shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.

Sources: https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/freight and https://insights.bellwether.example/freight/companion (accessed via team subscription code SUB-1359).
